'''Christian Bär''' (born 17 September 1962 in [[Kaiserslautern]]) is a German mathematician, whose research concerns [[differential geometry]] and [[mathematical physics]].<ref name="pnn">{{cite web|url=http://www.pnn.de/campus/138583/|title=Gekrümmte Flächen, geblähte Segel – Hochschulen in Potsdam – Studium|publisher=pnn.de|accessdate=2015-05-02}}</ref>

Bär enrolled on Ph.D. studies at the [[University of Bonn]] as a student of [[Hans Werner Ballmann]], and obtained his Ph.D. in 1990.<ref name="nodak">{{cite web|url=http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=30673|title=The Mathematics Genealogy Project – Christian Bär|publisher=genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu|accessdate=2015-05-02}}</ref>

He was elected president of the [[German Mathematical Society]], having assumed the post in 2011.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://dmv.mathematik.de/index.php/aktuell-presse/presseinformationen/26-ablage/184-christian-baer-ist-neuer-praesident |title=Christian Bär ist neuer Präsident |access-date=2015-05-02 |archive-date=2016-08-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160820034713/https://dmv.mathematik.de/index.php/aktuell-presse/presseinformationen/26-ablage/184-christian-baer-ist-neuer-praesident |url-status=dead }}</ref>
